al1.en: A basketball commentary account. Where the opinions go before they become products.
al1.zh: 一个篮球评论账号。观点先在这里出现，然后才变成产品。 [NEED CONTENT]

al2.en: My own account on studying, building and living abroad.
al2.zh: 我自己的账号，关于读书、做东西和在国外生活。 [NEED CONTENT]

al3.en: A campus mutual-help platform I led as a student venture. Best Creativity Award, 2023.
al3.zh: 我作为负责人带的校园互助平台创业项目，2023 年获最佳创意奖。

byLede.en: Most of what I've built came out of something I do on weekends. That isn't a coincidence — it's the only reliable way I've found to know whether a problem is real.
byLede.zh: 我做出来的大部分东西，都来自周末在干的事。这不是巧合 —— 这是我目前唯一可靠的、用来判断一个问题是否真实存在的方法。

byMkB.en: I read about companies more than I trade. What they sell, how the money actually moves, and why a decision looked sensible at the time.
byMkB.zh: 我读公司比交易多。他们卖什么、钱到底怎么流动、以及为什么当时那个决定看起来是合理的。

byNegot.en: One of these paid off literally: during university sports week I negotiated a 100-cup drinks sponsorship out of a hotpot chain.
byNegot.zh: 其中一项真的换来过收益：大学运动会期间，我从一家火锅连锁谈下了 100 多杯饮品赞助。

byTitle.en: Six sports, one stock market, and a habit of arguing.
byTitle.zh: 六项运动，一个股市，和一个爱辩论的毛病。

coBody.en: I'm in Singapore, graduating in January 2027, and looking for product roles where the brief is still vague. If you've read this far, you probably already know what you'd want me to work on.
coBody.zh: 我在新加坡，2027 年 1 月毕业，想找那种需求还很模糊的产品岗位。如果你读到这里，大概已经知道想让我做什么了。

coTitle.zh: 一起做点有意思的东西。

cu1b.en: Building fast enough that I'm testing the idea, not the code.
cu1b.zh: 做得足够快，测的是想法，不是代码。

cu2b.en: Prediction mechanics, community leagues, remote officiating.
cu2b.zh: 预测机制、社区联赛、远程执裁。

cu3b.en: Two accounts: one about building things, one about basketball.
cu3b.zh: 两个账号：一个讲做东西，一个讲篮球。

cu4b.en: Companies and business models, mostly as a reading habit.
cu4b.zh: 公司和商业模式，主要作为一个阅读习惯。

cu5b.en: The degree at NUS, and what to actually do with it by January 2027.
cu5b.zh: 新国大的这个学位，以及到 2027 年 1 月要拿它做什么。

cuTitle.en: What I'm poking at right now

ex1b.en: Six enterprise website projects at once, SATA CommHealth among them. I turn a client's business requirements into proposals, project plans, sitemaps and page-level content, then keep client, design and development pointed the same way through every review gate.
ex1b.zh: 同时推进六个企业网站项目，其中包括 SATA CommHealth。我把客户的业务需求转化成提案、项目计划、网站架构和具体页面内容，再在每一个评审节点上，让客户、设计和开发对齐同一个方向。

ex1c.en: I also research competitors and category leaders, so brand positioning and feature decisions start from what already exists rather than from taste.
ex1c.zh: 同时调研同行业与头部网站，让品牌定位和功能规划从「已经存在什么」出发，而不是从审美出发。

ex1r.zh: 数字项目产品经理实习生

ex2b.en: I hosted community football nights — organising before, coordinating on the pitch, collecting feedback after, cutting the short-form video. Then I went back to the numbers with the IR team: slot scheduling, venue utilisation, revenue per game.
ex2b.zh: 我主持社区足球局 —— 赛前组织、场上协调、赛后收集反馈、剪短视频。然后和 IR 团队一起回到数据上：时段排期、场地利用率、单场收入。

ex2c.en: On the growth side, I worked on event structure, pricing logic and engagement, and tracked attendance, repeat play and how different time slots actually performed.
ex2c.zh: 在增长这边，我参与活动结构、定价逻辑和用户参与度的优化，并统计出勤率、复购情况，以及不同时段的真实表现。

ex2r.zh: 客户体验与发展实习生

ex2s.zh: 出勤 · 定价 · 留存

ex3b.en: Research into shared financial services and industry-finance integration for tobacco enterprises: sector analysis, case studies, and the reporting materials that went with them.
ex3b.zh: 研究烟草企业的财务共享与产融结合模式：行业分析、案例调研，以及配套的汇报材料。

ex3c.en: From meeting minutes alone I wrote 20+ process documents and drew 20+ Visio flowcharts — the unglamorous work that turns a handover into something repeatable.
ex3c.zh: 仅凭会议纪要，独立编写了 20 多份财务流程文档，并绘制 20 多张 Visio 流程图 —— 不好看，但能让工作交接变成一件可复制的事。

ex3s.zh: 20+ 流程文档 · 20+ Visio 流程图

ex4b.en: Reviewed overseas promotional campaign sites at volume, then rewrote the method that did the reviewing.
ex4b.zh: 大批量审核海外促销活动网站，然后把审核方法本身重写了一遍。

ex5b.en: China Badminton Open: official WeChat and Weibo content, promo video edits, and the meetings with the Changzhou Sports Bureau, title sponsor YONEX and Viktor Axelsen's team.
ex5b.zh: 中国羽毛球公开赛：官方公众号与微博内容、宣传视频剪辑，以及和常州市体育局、冠名商 YONEX、安塞龙团队对接的那些会。

exTitle.zh: 五段经历，五种不同的问题。

ftMade.zh: 由 AI 与人类好奇心共同设计与搭建。

ftState.zh: 在商业、产品和好奇心的交叉处做东西。

h1a.zh: 大多数想法停在提案阶段。

heroLede.en: 我是卢一森 ——专业出身,现在做产品。在 Orfeostory 同时推进六个企业网站项目,在 Stranger Soccer 做社区足球运营,在安永独立完成 20 多份财务流程文档。业余时间做了一个 NBA 预测平台,和一套给我妈生意用的排课系统。
heroLede.zh: 我是卢一森 —— 日语专业出身，现在做产品。在 Orfeostory 同时推进六个企业网站项目，在 Stranger Soccer 做社区足球运营，在安永独立完成 20 多份财务流程文档。业余时间做了一个 NBA 预测平台，和一套给我妈生意用的排课系统。

portraitBadge.en: Currently building digital products at Orfeostory, Singapore
portraitBadge.zh: 目前在新加坡 Orfeostory 做数字产品

pr1b.en: An NBA prediction platform I planned and built end to end — fixtures, user picks, a points system, a leaderboard. The interesting part isn't the predictions. It's the mechanics that decide whether anyone comes back on the next game day.
pr1b.zh: 一个我从头规划并搭出来的 NBA 预测平台 —— 赛程、用户下注、积分体系、排行榜。有意思的不是预测本身，而是决定「下一个比赛日还有没有人回来」的那套机制。

pr2b.en: Pickup basketball in Singapore, refereed remotely from China. Splitting one game across two countries is a strange constraint, which is exactly why I want to find out whether it holds up.
pr2b.zh: 新加坡的线下篮球局，由中国的裁判远程执裁。把一场球拆到两个国家是个奇怪的限制条件，所以我才想知道它到底成不成立。

pr3b.en: My mother's business was running on a spreadsheet and a phone. I built her a scheduling and management back office instead. First real user, first real feedback loop, and the first product I couldn't quietly abandon.
pr3b.zh: 我妈的生意原本靠一张表格和一部手机在跑。我给她做了一套排课与管理后台。第一个真实用户，第一个真实反馈循环，也是第一个我没法悄悄放弃的产品。

prLede.en: Side projects are where I learn fastest. Nobody signs anything off, so nothing exists unless it actually works.
prLede.zh: 个人项目是我学得最快的地方。没有人签字批准，所以除非真的能用，否则不会有东西存在。

prTitle.en: Things nobody asked me to build.
prTitle.zh: 没有人要求我做的东西。

s1b.en: Before changing anything at Shanghai Suoao, I reviewed 20,000+ promotional websites and produced or checked 5,000+ templates.
s1b.zh: 在梭翱动手改任何东西之前，我先审了 2 万多个促销网站，产出并审核了 5 千多套模板。

s2b.en: The bottleneck wasn't the people doing the reviews. It was that nobody had written down what "correct" meant.
s2b.zh: 瓶颈不在审核的人身上，而在于从来没有人把「什么算合格」写下来。

s3b.en: I wrote the standard operating document: what to check, in what order, and what happens when a template fails.
s3b.zh: 我写了标准流程文档：查什么、按什么顺序查、不合格之后怎么办。

s4b.en: Two days of work became two hours. Same team, same tools, a different method.
s4b.zh: 两天的工作量变成两小时。同一批人，同一套工具，换了一个方法。

sp1.en: Organised the inter-faculty league at UIR. Ran match nights at Stranger Soccer.
sp1.zh: 在国关组织过院系足球联赛。在 Stranger Soccer 主持过球局。

sp2.en: Two products and a commentary account came out of this one.
sp2.zh: 两个产品和一个评论账号都从这里来。

sp3.en: Worked the China Badminton Open in Changzhou, 2023.
sp3.zh: 2023 年在常州做过中国羽毛球公开赛。

thLede.en: International relations, then Japanese, then venture creation. Consulting, sports marketing, operations, digital product. Different rooms, same job: work out what the actual problem is, find the opening, get the people and the pieces together, and make the thing exist.
thLede.zh: 国际关系学院、日语专业，再到新国大风险创造。咨询、体育营销、运营、数字产品。房间不一样，做的事情是同一件：搞清楚真正的问题是什么，找到切口，把人和资源组织起来，然后把东西做出来。

thNote.en: Here is one whole version of that, start to finish — three months at a company most people have never heard of.
thNote.zh: 下面是一次完整的过程，从头到尾 —— 发生在一家大多数人没听过的公司，三个月。

thTitle.zh: 简历看起来很杂。其实不杂。
